description: Shared Renovate preset for bottrall's repos. Extend with "github>bottrall/deps".

customManagers.description: Gem dependencies declared in gemspecs, which the bundler manager doesn't read

packageRules.description: One PR for every non-major update, merged automatically once the repo's required checks pass
Majors get their own PRs and are never merged automatically
A new gemspec constraint stales the PATH section of Gemfile.lock, which frozen installs in CI reject, so regenerate it in the same commit
Lock file maintenance regenerates Gemfile.lock with the Bundler it already records, so BUNDLED WITH never moves on its own; bump it in the same weekly PR
Repos call deps's fix workflow on main on purpose: its Anthropic federation rule only accepts job_workflow_ref fix.yml@refs/heads/main
ruby/setup-ruby's v1 is a branch rather than a tag, so github-tags can't resolve its digest and the pin would be dropped
